description: Source code implementing whitespace rules and checks for a Git-related project, including functions for parsing, checking, and fixing whitespace in lines.

classes.name: struct whitespace_rule
classes.description: Defines a whitespace rule with name, bits, and flags for error loosening and default exclusion.

methods.name: parse_whitespace_rule
methods.description: Parses a string to produce a whitespace rule bitmask.

methods.name: whitespace_rule
methods.description: Determines the whitespace rule for a given file based on attributes.

methods.name: whitespace_error_string
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing whitespace errors based on a bitmask.

methods.name: ws_check_emit_1
methods.description: Checks a line for whitespace issues and optionally emits highlighted output.

methods.name: ws_check_emit
methods.description: Wrapper for ws_check_emit_1, used for checking and emitting whitespace issues.

methods.name: ws_check
methods.description: Checks a line for whitespace issues without emitting output.

methods.name: ws_blank_line
methods.description: Determines if a line is blank (only whitespace).

methods.name: ws_fix_copy
methods.description: Copies a line into a buffer while fixing whitespace according to rules.
